items.text: We have Zay Flowers (hamstring) out in projections right now. Still possible he plays; will keep late swap in mind for Bateman/Andrews DFS situations. No new info changing that as of early Sunday.
items.why: Team not counting on him; opportunity data favors alternatives
items.implication: DFS late-swap candidates Bateman/Andrews elevated; standard leagues sit Flowers
items.opportunity: Routes/targets shift to other Ravens skill players

items.text: Zay Flowers listed GTD (hamstring); team 'not counting on him playing'. ETR/Levitan have him OUT in projections (possible late swap for Bateman/Andrews DFS). True pregame workout decision ~90 min before 4:25 ET kickoff in Brazil.
items.why: Team not counting on him; limited practice Fri only after DNPs; field conditions factor
items.implication: Sit in most fantasy; monitor inactives. Boosts Ravens other pass-catchers and run game.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/snaps for secondary WRs and Mark Andrews if OUT

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams Grade 2 hamstring; doctors consider 3-to-4-week injury. Rapoport confirms; noted quick healer hoping to beat timeline. Out this week (Bagent Q).
items.implication: Sit/IR stash; Bagent or backup starts MNF and near-term. Multiple teams starting multi-QBs early.
items.opportunity: Backup QB and Bears skill upside short-term

items.text: Steelers WR Michael Pittman (foot/plantar), listed questionable, expected to play vs Bengals. Back after one week.
Steelers RB Jaylen Warren (shoulder), listed questionable, is expected to play vs Bengals.
items.why: Expected per sources; Dowdle OUT boosts him
items.implication: Start with confidence; full or near-full workload likely
items.opportunity: Elevated carries/snaps with Rico Dowdle out

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans (hip, Q) plans to play / good to go vs Arizona.
items.why: Plans to play per source; limited Fri after misses
items.implication: Start as WR2; some injury risk but expected full

items.text: No info yet on DJ Moore (shoulder) or AD Mitchell (finger); both 1pm games. Projecting Moore in (but limited), Mitchell out. Will update ASAP if wrong.
items.why: No fresh reports; default assumptions for early games
items.implication: Moore startable but capped; Mitchell sit
items.opportunity: Limited routes for Moore if active

items.text: Brock Bowers (knee, Q) expected to play. Levitan projecting him IN despite Q.
items.implication: TE1 start; full or near role

items.text: Puka Nacua doubtful for SNF at Denver mainly due to groin injury impacting explosiveness. Functionally can play but not at full explosiveness. Rams view short-term; possible return as soon as next week vs Eagles. Surgery not expected/needed currently.
items.why: Groin impacting explosiveness; no practice all week
items.implication: Expect OUT; Davante Adams elevated to WR1 volume. Monitor for W4 return.
items.opportunity: High target share for Adams and other Rams WRs/TEs

items.text: Nico Collins already ruled OUT second straight week (hamstring); has 'a decent chance' to return Week 4 vs Cowboys.
items.implication: Schultz continues elevated role; Collins stash for W4
items.opportunity: Schultz 28-30% target share / high routes with Collins out

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (stinger) and WR DeVonta Smith officially off injury report and good to go for MNF vs Bears.
items.implication: Full start confidence for both; Barkley RB1 upside vs Bears

items.text: With Nico Collins out, Dalton Schultz targeted on 30% routes / team-high 28% target share. Chuba Hubbard firmly lead role after Jonathon Brooks expected IR (Etienne also IR). London averages 20+ PPR/35% share/97 yds with Penix.
items.implication: Schultz TE start; Hubbard RB2; London smash with Penix
items.opportunity: Schultz high tgt%; Hubbard lead carries; London 35% share

items.text: Panthers WR Jalen Coker (ankle) should play today; Xavier Legette (knee) GTD. ETR lists Coker expected.
items.opportunity: Coker target share if Legette limited/out

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop (88.5); Dallas 30th in rush D allowing 173.5 ypg. Feed him.
items.why: Elite matchup vs poor run D; high prop

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches + 15% target share both games; RB7 utilization. PIT allows 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
Loves Chris Olave vs LV (double-digit tgts, high aDOT, LV allows high YPR); Dalton Schultz @ IND (28% tgt share w/ Collins out, IND soft vs TEs); Christian Watson vs ATL (WR8 util, high RZ share).
items.why: Volume + matchup edges; Schultz boosted by Collins OUT
items.implication: Strong WR/TE starts; Schultz TE1 upside this week
items.opportunity: Olave air yards; Schultz routes/tgts; Watson RZ

items.text: Hates Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX (31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble; tough run D); Travis Etienne vs LV (only 49% touches/38% 3rd-down snaps even w/ Kamara); Terry McLaurin vs SEA (worst WR fantasy D, low team total).
items.opportunity: Henderson rising post-Stevenson fumble; Hubbard clear lead post-Brooks

items.text: After Rhamondre Stevenson 1Q fumble last week, TreVeyon Henderson led Patriots backfield 65% snaps and out-touched him 16-5 rest of game. Gap narrowed but still ranks Stevenson ahead W3.
items.opportunity: 65% snaps, majority touches in bulk of game
